text: shall be weak as water: Heb. shall go into water
it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree: Or, it is the rod of my son, it despiseth every tree
terrors, by reason of the sword, shall be upon my people: Or, they are thrust down to the sword with my people
Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod?: Or, When the trial hath been, what then? shall they not also belong to the despising rod?
hands together: Heb. hand to hand
point: Or, glittering, or fear | wrapped: Or, sharpened
or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set: Heb. set thyself, take the left hand
parting of the way: Heb. mother of the way | arrows: Or, knives | images: Heb. Teraphim
captains: Or, battering rams. Heb. rams
to them that have sworn oaths: Or, for the oaths made unto them
I will overturn, overturn, overturn it: Heb. Perverted, perverted, perverted will I make it
Shall I cause it to return: Or, cause to it to return
